scenario.description: A plant manager must authorize temporary storage for 900 finished cartons after an outbound conveyor failure and finalize the storage layout, access clearance, and dispatch plan, with input from maintenance planning, environmental health and safety, and logistics.

shared_context.S1: The outbound conveyor serving the finished-goods warehouse is stopped, and 900 finished cartons are staged for dispatch.
shared_context.S2: Warehouse Zone C and adjacent Zone D are currently clear of production materials and can be used for temporary staging.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding decision on the temporary storage arrangement and dispatch controls.
shared_context.S4: The plant's normal warehouse review includes maintenance, environmental health and safety, and logistics before a temporary staging plan is authorized.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed in the maintenance diagnostic this morning that the conveyor drive replacement and test run will take exactly 14 hours; the repair estimate is still in the open maintenance ticket and has not reached Maya's daily summary.

PF2.text: Priya's floor-load and egress inspection found that Zone C may hold exactly 600 cartons and Zone D exactly 300 cartons, with a continuous aisle clearance of at least 1.5 meters required through both areas; she completed the inspection yesterday but has not uploaded the signed report.

PF3.text: Jonas confirmed with the carriers that exactly 500 cartons must be dispatched from Dock 1 by 18:00 and the remaining exactly 400 cartons from Dock 3 by 22:00; the carrier confirmations are in his email and have not been entered in the warehouse board.

settlement_schema.commitment_instruction: Include a commitment for the conveyor repair completion at the 14-hour mark. Its type may be conveyor_repair_completion, conveyor_restoration, maintenance_followup, or maintenance_update.

acceptance_conditions: Temporary staging must be authorized for exactly 14 hours.
Exactly 600 cartons must be assigned to Zone C and exactly 300 cartons to Zone D.
The staging plan must preserve at least 1.5 meters of aisle clearance.
Exactly 500 cartons must be scheduled from Dock 1 by 18:00.
Exactly 400 cartons must be scheduled from Dock 3 by 22:00.

The plan must include a commitment for conveyor repair completion at the 14-hour mark, using a commitment type of conveyor_repair_completion, conveyor_restoration, maintenance_followup, or maintenance_update.
The logistics carrier instructions must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['conveyor_repair_completion', 'conveyor_restoration', 'maintenance_followup', 'maintenance_update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact 14-hour repair estimate changes the authorized staging duration from an unspecified short-term hold to exactly 14 hours and requires a conveyor repair completion commitment.
The inspection changes the layout to exactly 600 cartons in Zone C and 300 cartons in Zone D and sets the required aisle clearance at exactly 1.5 meters.
The carrier confirmations change the dispatch plan to exactly 500 cartons from Dock 1 by 18:00 and exactly 400 cartons from Dock 3 by 22:00, and require those instructions to be cited.
